preserved_prior_attempt.outcome: producer raised AttributeError and exited 1 before writing any RESULT.json
preserved_prior_attempt.cause: a leftover list initialiser was used as a dict for the deletion relation

identical_scored_candidates.class: harness design flaw, not a scientific result
identical_scored_candidates.detail: the unmodified original EnergyCompleteSAA._insert_u computes trial-minus-base but does not record its scored candidates, so the registered "identical scored candidates" gate has no reference-side log to compare and records FAIL.
identical_scored_candidates.consequence: the candidate-side score arithmetic is therefore not compared against the original; the insertion choice itself is still compared, because both arms must produce identical events and those gates passed.

producer_reported_no_failure / producer_.detail: the audit refuses to certify a producer that exited 1; this is intended behaviour.

at_least_one_trial_kept_per_removed_base.detail: the check identified base entries by Python object identity across two separately loaded JSON logs, so every candidate entry was mis-classified as a trial. The producer-side deletion check does not use identity across objects and passed.
at_least_one_trial_kept_per_removed_base.consequence: not a finding about the component; recorded as a defect in this audit check.

gates_that_passed: identical insertion choices between the unmodified original and the candidate
identical terminal energy and distance hex
candidate distance log is the reference log with in-order deletions
every deleted entry is a same-loop base call
all 1042 reference and 733 candidate distance values independently recomputed by ordered double sums
immutable distance matrix and public parameter digest unchanged

timing.reading: the candidate removes 29.7 percent of the route-distance evaluations but is not faster: its mean timed section is higher than the reference in both interleaved pairs. Reducing call counts is not a speedup, and this bounded section is small relative to process noise, so no acceleration claim is made in either direction.

verified_substantive_result.conclusion: extending the lazy reuse to the whole fixed archived scenario raises the removed-work fraction from 13/109 to 309/1042 while leaving every exactness gate that could run intact, and it still does not produce a measured speedup. The pickup runtime path therefore stays unqualified and is not the route to an online gain.
